sheet:
# Answer sheet

- The PM is the user whose role is `PM`; there is one PM role.
- Epic ids are UUIDs, like every other id in the API.
- The note appears at the top of the epic detail page, above the task list.
- Notes are plain text, no formatting, no attachments.
- Authentication is the existing Firebase session.
